brief:
**BLUF:** Veterans Day events dominate today in the core area, with parades in Tazewell and Bluefield, Va., and a veterans breakfast in Princeton, W.Va. Bluefield, W.Va., police released a list of 30 people wanted on municipal court warrants. A Frost Advisory remains in effect for multiple counties including McDowell and Buchanan until 10 a.m. Monday.[[1]](https://www.wvva.com/2026/11/07/mercer-county-veterans-breakfast-returns-organizer-hands-off-event/)

## LAW ENFORCEMENT AND COURTS
**Bluefield, W.Va. (Mercer County)**: On Nov. 7, the Bluefield Police Department released a list of 30 individuals with outstanding bench or arrest warrants from Bluefield Municipal Court. Warrants cover offenses including traffic violations, DUI, assault, possession of controlled substances, drug paraphernalia, destruction of property, obstructing an officer, and prostitution. Those listed are advised to contact the department at 304-327-6101 (option 1) to confirm status; failure to address warrants may result in arrest and detention until court appearance or bond. Names include Dalijah Craighead (Bluefield, WV), Nathan Baird (Cross Lanes, WV), Justin Addair (Bluefield, WV), and others from the region.[[2]](https://www.lootpress.com/bluefield-police-department-releases-list-of-30-individuals-wanted-on-municipal-court-warrants/)

Nothing else reported in the last 24 hours for Tazewell County Sheriff’s Office, Virginia State Police Division IV, Richlands/Tazewell/Cedar Bluff/Bluefield VA police, or Mercer County Sheriff/WV State Police (Princeton).

## FIRE, EMS AND RESCUE
Nothing reported in the last 24 hours.

## HAZARDS, WEATHER AND ROADS
**Core area (multiple WV counties including McDowell, Wyoming, Logan, Mingo, Buchanan VA)**: Frost Advisory issued by NWS Charleston WV at 10:52 a.m. EST Nov. 8 remains in effect until 10 a.m. EST Nov. 9.[[3]](https://www.wvva.com/2026/11/06/tazewell-hold-veterans-day-parade-nov-8/)

**Bluefield/Tazewell area (US 460)**: Appalachian Power utility work on Sunday, Nov. 9, expected to cause rolling traffic stops and delays from about 8:30 a.m. to 2 p.m. near Grandview Memorial Gardens between Bluefield and Tazewell, Va. Flagging crews and police will be present.[[4]](https://www.newsbreak.com/lootpress-1588259/4336766327260-traffic-delays-expected-sunday-for-utility-work-on-u-s-route-460)

Nothing else reported for VDOT/WVDOH closures on listed routes or other hazards.

## GOVERNMENT AND POLITICS
**Tazewell County, Va.**: The county imposed a nine-month moratorium on data centers (effective until July 28, 2027, unless modified), to allow time for zoning and development standards on issues including setbacks, noise, energy/water use, and environmental impacts.[[5]](https://www.25newsnow.com/2026/10/31/tazewell-county-imposes-9-month-data-center-moratorium/)

**Tazewell Circuit Court, Va.**: Hearing on challenge to Virginia Ballot Question 1 (abortion amendment) rescheduled from Nov. 13 to Nov. 24 due to judge’s schedule conflict. Judge Hurley to hear arguments; preliminary injunction sought.[[6]](https://x.com/TFFVA/status/2118791188484387055)

## ECONOMY AND OTHER
**Tazewell, Va.**: Tazewell Today and Tazewell Chamber of Commerce hosting Veterans Day parade at 2 p.m. Sunday, Nov. 8, from high school to Main Street, ending with Quilt of Valor presentation to a local 99-year-old WWII veteran.[[3]](https://www.wvva.com/2026/11/06/tazewell-hold-veterans-day-parade-nov-8/)

**Bluefield, Va.**: Fourth annual Veterans Day parade held Nov. 7, starting with JROTC cadets and Graham High School marching band; floats from Rotary Club and VFW Post 9696.[[7]](https://www.wvva.com/2026/11/07/bluefield-va-holds-fourth-annual-veterans-day-parade/)

**Princeton, W.Va. (Mercer County)**: Mercer County Veterans Breakfast and Stand Down held Nov. 7 at Lifeline Church of God (250 Oakvale Road), with program at 9 a.m. and breakfast at 9:30 a.m. Organizer Omar Aboulhosn handing off to Diamond Wolfe after 11 years.[[1]](https://www.wvva.com/2026/11/07/mercer-county-veterans-breakfast-returns-organizer-hands-off-event/)

## WATCH -- NEXT 48 HOURS
- Frost Advisory ends 10 a.m. Monday.
- US 460 utility work and delays Sunday morning/afternoon.
- Tazewell Circuit Court abortion amendment hearing: Nov. 24.
- Ongoing: Bluefield WV wanted persons list; contact police to resolve.
